fee_notes: The Unit Franchise Fee is $12,000 for a single-unit franchise, paid in a lump sum at signing. Additional initial fees for a single-unit franchise include: Technology Transfer Fee ($20,000), Store Pre-Opening Fee ($17,000), Design Fee ($3,000), Security Deposit ($10,000, potentially refundable), Equipment Fee ($91,000–$103,000), Utensils ($2,500–$3,300), and Initial Inventory ($15,000–$35,000). For an Area Development Franchise, the Area Development Fee is $100,000 (nonrefundable, paid in lump sum at signing), with additional fees including Technology Transfer Fee ($20,000), Store Pre-Opening Fee ($17,000), Design Fee ($3,000), Security Deposit ($30,000, potentially refundable), Equipment Fee ($181,000–$217,000), Utensils ($7,500–$9,900), and Initial Inventory ($90,000–$135,000). Under an Area Development Agreement, some initial fees (including franchise fee, technology transfer fee, and pre-opening support fee) may be reduced or waived. All fees except the security deposit are non-refundable.
